lines.text: A flame shines in every direction, so most of its light is wasted.
In 1823, at the Cordouan lighthouse, Augustin Fresnel's lens gathered it with thin rings of glass.
lines.say: In eighteen twenty-three, at the Cordouan lighthouse, Augustin Fray-nel's lens gathered it with thin rings of glass.

lines.text: Each ring bends its share of the light into a flat beam.
Ships could see it from more than 32 kilometres away.
lines.say: Ships could see it from more than thirty-two kilometres away.
